summary: break stops a loop early and continue skips to the next pass. Use them when you are searching for something or need to skip bad data.
notes: continue jumps to the next pass. The "Passing" line is skipped for -1.
break leaves the loop completely, so 75 is never checked.
Java has no for...else. Set a boolean like foundFailing before break and check it after the loop.
pitfall: Code on the line after break or continue, inside the same braces, causes the compile error: unreachable statement.
